name: @vssaros/dsh-scheduler
description: VsSaros Scheduler module for DeepSeek Harness. Host side: self-built schedule engine (occupies the `schedule` service key; tasks live in <dataRoot>/scheduler/tasks.json, not in Sessions) served over /x/scheduler/api/*. Client side: a **self-built** workbench (17KB, shared `wb-*` primitives) that reads those same-origin routes — no official `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-schedule` chunk (the self-built engine has no `@Remote`, so the official page's `remote.schedule` data source could never work without an adapter layer; it also had to be re-copied on every upstream bump). SSR page at /x/scheduler/ + legacy migration stay as before.

workbench.title: 自动化任务
workbench.description: 自动化任务（自建调度）：定时/周期/一次性任务，支持触发循环（loop）与投递历史。
